JYNLAB scans the App Store for zombie apps — high downloads, terrible ratings. Those gaps are market opportunities hiding in plain sight. It surfaces the niche, aggregates user complaints into insight, and sends daily keyword alerts. Available now at jynlab.com with a lifetime deal.
ADMADE is an AI-powered ad creative generation platform. Describe your product and audience, get back ready-to-run creatives. Still in development — watch this space.

FunnelLens is an AI funnel diagnostic agent. Walk it through your ad → landing page → lead gen → sales flow and it tells you where you're losing people and why. Built for growth PMs and marketers who are tired of guessing.
qrefiner helps you write better user research questions using The Mom Test framework — so you actually learn something useful instead of hearing what people think you want to hear. Find it on GitHub.

pm-prd-generator automates the boilerplate parts of writing a PRD so you can focus on the actual decisions. It uses LLMs to generate structure, context, and edge-case sections from a short brief. On GitHub.
